groups.defect: The second requireNonNull in the AccessTokenContext constructor checks grantType again instead of rawTokenId, so a null rawTokenId is never rejected.
groups.rationale: All five point at line 73 and describe the same copy-paste mistake, which one edit fixes.

groups.defect: isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6) and inverts the equality check, so it never checks the grant type; the comment saying the shortcut starts at the 4th character is also wrong.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same wrong offset and inverted comparison in the AssertEvents matcher. s_15c59a87 also flags the misleading comment, so the merged comment must carry that too.

groups.defect: The getShortcut() javadoc suggests 3-letter shortcuts, but the decoder requires exactly 2 characters. Shortcut length and non-null are not validated (a null shortcut causes an NPE in postInit), and the new abstract SPI method has no default, so existing custom implementations break.
groups.rationale: Both report that the 3-letter javadoc contradicts the encoder's fixed 2-character format. s_9c9743f6 adds missing validation, the null-key NPE and SPI compatibility.
